fieldData.awb---key-feature-1-content:
One bill record per PDF, with unsure fields held

Globex Industrial emails INV-20817 to the AP inbox at $3,412.50, and the due date sits under a smudge on the scan. That one field waits for Maria Lopez to confirm, and every other field is already filled.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-1:
Five lines coded on arrival, one left for finance

On Initech Supply's INV-3381, five of six lines arrive coded like Initech's past bills. Shipping boxes go to 6100 Supplies and the forklift service to 6400 Repairs. The label printer, $240.00, has no history with this vendor. Sam Ortiz picks its account.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
Billable hours become client invoices on the 1st

Hours logged against each client in October turn into one draft invoice per client on Nov 1. Acme's draft comes to $6,300.00, for 42 hours at $150. Ana Ruiz reviews the four drafts in one list, and nothing goes out until she approves.
fieldData.acrm---integration-feature-4:
The customer has the invoice before the van leaves

A technician closes the job on a phone, and the labor and parts on it become an invoice. Job 4471 bills 1.5 hours at $120 and a $68.40 shutoff valve, $248.40 in all. Dana Whitfield pays from her phone, and the PDF stays attached to the job record.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { emailedPdfs: "Build invoice automation for my AP inbox. Read every vendor PDF into vendor, invoice number, invoice date, due date, line items, and total. When a field is hard to read, like a smudged due date, send only that field to Maria Lopez to confirm and fill in the rest. Save each invoice as a bill record with the PDF attached.", glCodingByLine: "Build a coding step for my supplier invoices. Give each line the GL account that the same item from that vendor was coded to before. When an item has never been bought from that vendor, send the line to Sam Ortiz in finance to pick an account, and post the coded bill to Xero once every line has one.", timesheetInvoices: "Build automated invoicing for my agency. On the 1st of each month, turn the hours logged against each client into one draft invoice at that client's hourly rate. Show me all the drafts in one list to approve, then email each invoice with a Stripe payment link and record it in Xero.", fieldServiceJobs: "Build invoicing for my plumbing business. When a technician marks a job complete on their phone, create an invoice from the labor hours and parts on that job, email it to the customer with a payment link, and attach the PDF to the job record so the office can see it." };
